component: Primary Director role, scene and master typed effects

requirements.scope: V3-13 role/scene/master EQ, dynamics and explicit room effects, with ordered numeric controls and recovery.

decisions.schema: No version bump: optional ordered effects omitted when empty at every legacy serialization level. Existing empty-chain JSON/fingerprints remain byte-compatible.
decisions.typed_effects: Use the existing audio.models.Effect, effect_presets decoder/checked_chain and canonical AudioRuntime/DSP; no raw filtergraph or new DSP implementation.
decisions.timeline: Enabled tempo is refused. Accepted role, scene and master processing preserves the exact sample grid; tails are bounded at that level's existing end. Whole master effects execute once; exported chapters are exact frame slices of that accepted processed master.
decisions.gain: Role processing applies canonical effects and the selected gain/pan once. Already mixed scene/master buses use canonical convert without a second routing gain or implicit safety limiter. Positive gain consumes headroom and may clip; docs require explicit controls and measurement.
decisions.cache: Raw speech keys remain unchanged. Processed nodes bind exact ordered/bypass numeric chains, source digest/frame format and canonical processing code identity. Accepted-input stamps are checked inside existing cache admission/publication and full digests are rechecked afterward.
decisions.stems: Role stems contain role effects only; scene/master buses are not represented by those stems. The first transition to effect-specific role-stem keys may rebuild mix stems once, with an explicit progress/result cache note; it does not synthesize unchanged accepted speech. Subsequent affected-scene/role work has bounded content-addressed reuse.
decisions.resource_plan: Existing broker/lock/owner boundaries remain. Additional retained PCM factor is2 for any enabled role chain +2 for any enabled scene chain +4 for enabled master chain. cache_bytes=estimated_pcm_bytes*(6+2*stem_count+factor)+16MiB; output estimate unchanged. Empty/wholly-bypassed chains retain old admission estimate.
decisions.cleanup: Existing native owned_process, retained temporary contexts, render lock, shared resource lease and pending cleanup callbacks are reused. The new actual-child tests require the exact stage/lock/lease to survive direct or masked pending cleanup.
decisions.source: Script bytes/source provenance are unchanged. Role/master chains survive parsing; a scene chain follows only a unique unchanged chapter title. Renamed/deleted/ambiguous reviewed titles refuse before saving.
decisions.ui: The existing shared ordered-effects modal is reached from one Director button. Scope/current project/editor/library checks bracket the modal, and saved expected-fingerprint CAS precedes in-memory replacement. Editing does not start generation or playback.
decisions.backup: Existing dynamic Project.from_dict is the typed primary-project validator. Native5/flat4 recovery is passive and retains the existing new-output requirement. Primary publication voice metadata uses Role.to_dict, preserving empty-chain legacy shape.
decisions.docs: Only an appended Director section in audio_engine.md; deliver its inverse hunk for composition with other independently reviewed append-only guide changes.

planned_tests.scope: Actual synthetic PCM/FFmpeg, exact frame/hash/order, selective cache/recovery, resource refusal and actual pending families.
Actual controller/store/CAS and same-handler modal boundaries; old 24 assertion lines retained.
Actual native format5 and foreign-flat4, real typed keymap, passive restored output refusal, rehashed malformed effect rejection.

native.uses: Existing actual wx/Flite/FFmpeg production only; no additional speech job.
native.proof: Real scope picker and typed numeric controls; accepted full-master PCM equals concatenated chapter PCM with exact file hashes and source fingerprint.

route_audit.calls: Existing installed probe and full-bundle probe both propagate the actual script exit; no fixed ten-check count predicate was found in those two invocation blocks.

review_scopes.scope: Serialization/UI/persistence/typed backup plus callable fixture boundaries
Real native scope/control APIs and exact PCM assertions
Exact Director pending-family observer isolation successor6191e8ff

qualifications: All new implementation and tests are source reviewed only; execution awaits the integrated candidate.
No donor CI, older head PASS, listening or human NVDA qualification is transferred.
No private assets, account/consent changes, workflow/ref mutation or new production authority.

fixture_isolation.details: The real DSP wrapper records only exact staged render.wav argv under this project. Every native child still delegates to actual_stop; only the recorded target gets fixture assertions and synthetic cleanup uncertainty. Foreign-thread DSP/pending factory calls delegate unchanged.
